Honestly, is the pricier one worth the extra, or is the cheaper one fine?
If you’re choosing between these two, the “pricier” one is the All-Inclusive Wood Wick Sample Kit ($49.95), and the “cheaper” one is the Sweet Treat DIY Candle Kit ($24.99).
Is the pricier one worth it? Yes—if you already have (or plan to keep buying) wax, vessels, and fragrance. The Sample Kit is made for testing multiple wick options to find the right one for your exact candle, which can save you money by avoiding failed burns and re-pours.
Is the cheaper one fine? Totally—if your goal is to make finished candles right away with an all-in-one kit.
